云崖隘口硝烟散尽，甲贺死士全军覆没。

狭窄的悬空石阶上残留着淡淡的黑气与爆破余温，山风卷过，吹散最后一缕忍道煞气，整片云崖终于恢复安稳。

众人稍作调息，稳住斗法波动的灵气，整顿行装，再度迈步，顺着石阶继续向上。

越过隘口之后，山路豁然开阔，云雾渐渐稀薄，天光洒落山巅，视野瞬间通透。

长白山主峰绝顶，一片平整宽阔的山巅台地映入眼帘。

台地中央，矗立着一座恢弘古老的石质祭坛，分三重错落而建，层层向上，直达中心主祭台。

第一重外坛，广阔空旷，地面刻满连环东瀛咒纹，四周立着数十根阴森鬼柱，柱上缠绕锁链、悬挂枯骨，阴风绕柱，鬼气森森；第二重中坛，遍布漆黑蛊池、毒草灵圃，雾气缭绕，蛊腥冲天，无数凶蛊在池中翻滚游走，弥漫致命毒瘴；第三重核心主坛，矗立一座丈高黑石祭台，祭台内部嵌在龙脉节点之上，台面刻满血色献祭纹路，三面立着三名身着狩衣的阴阳大咒师，闭目诵念咒文，周身黑气盘旋，操控大阵运转。

主祭台上空，黑雾凝聚成一尊巨大的鬼将虚影，身躯魁梧如山，面目狰狞可怖，眼窝赤红，周身缠绕锁链煞气，悬浮半空，冷漠俯瞰整座山巅，散发着碾压一切的恐怖威压。

整座三重祭坛，阴气冲天、蛊气弥漫、咒音缭绕、鬼煞盘旋，死死锁住长白山龙脉主干，地底隐隐传来地脉震颤之声，献祭大阵已然运转到极致，黑色煞气顺着龙脉脉络不断往下蔓延，侵蚀整片关外地脉。

“这就是东瀛三派经营多年的龙脉献祭祭坛。”林佳望着眼前恢弘又邪异的景象，语气凝重，“三重设防，外坛守兵、中坛万蛊、主坛咒师鬼将，环环相扣，层层绝杀。”

织田美子被李二牛押在后方，望着山巅祭坛，眼神复杂：“外坛残余甲贺忍者全数列阵把守，中坛是九菊一派所有顶尖养蛊师坐镇，操控万蛊绝阵，主坛三名大咒师主持献祭，鬼将镇守空域，你们就算闯到这里，也根本破不了这绝杀之局。”

胡九郎目光缓缓扫过三重祭坛，天眼洞悉所有阵纹脉络、气场节点、人手排布，片刻后沉声开口：

“外坛以鬼柱为阵眼，布阴魂锁煞阵，把守忍者只是幌子，真正杀局是鬼柱禁锢的万千阴魂；中坛万蛊绝阵以蛊池为根基，毒瘴封空，蛊虫遍地，还有多名养蛊师暗中操控，阵在蛊在，阵破蛊亡；主坛献祭大阵连通地底龙脉，三名大咒师互为犄角，鬼将掌控空域，只要咒师不倒下，大阵就不会停，劫煞就会持续扩散。”

“想要破局，必须循序渐进。”胡九郎快速敲定攻坚方略，“先清外坛，毁鬼柱阵眼，扫清留守忍者，断绝阴魂助力；再闯中坛，破万蛊绝阵，制服九菊养蛊师，净化毒瘴蛊池；最后冲上主坛，打断咒师献祭，击溃鬼将，彻底毁了龙脉祭阵。”

The smoke cleared from Yunya Pass, and all the dead soldiers of Jiahe were wiped out.

A faint trace of black air and residual heat from the explosion remained on the narrow suspended stone steps. The mountain wind swept by, blowing away the last wisp of the evil spirit of Nindo, and the entire cloud cliff finally returned to stability.

Everyone adjusted their breath for a moment, stabilized the fluctuating spiritual energy of the fighting skills, packed up their gear, and took steps again, continuing up the stone steps.

After crossing the pass, the mountain road suddenly opened up, the clouds and fog gradually thinned, the skylight fell on the mountain top, and the vision was instantly clear.

The main peak of Changbai Mountain is at the top, and a flat and wide mountaintop platform comes into view.

In the center of the platform, stands a magnificent and ancient stone altar. It is built in three staggered layers, rising layer by layer, directly to the main altar in the center.

The first level of the outer altar is vast and empty. The ground is engraved with a series of Japanese curse patterns. There are dozens of gloomy ghost pillars around it. The pillars are wrapped with chains and dead bones.Rolling around, filled with deadly poisonous miasma; the third core main altar, stands a foot-high black stone altar, the inside of the altar is embedded on the dragon vein node, the table is engraved with blood-colored sacrificial patterns, and on three sides stand three great Yin-Yang spell masters in hunting robes, reciting incantations with their eyes closed, black energy hovering around their bodies, controlling the movement of the formation.

Above the main altar, the black mist condensed into a huge shadow of a ghost general, with a body as tall as a mountain, a hideous face, and red eye sockets. The body was wrapped with chains and evil aura, suspended in mid-air, overlooking the entire mountaintop indifferently, exuding a terrifying pressure that crushed everything.

The entire three-layered altar was filled with yin energy, poisonous energy, curse sounds, and evil spirits circling, tightly locking the main trunk of Changbai Mountain's dragon veins. There was a faint sound of trembling earth veins from the ground. The sacrificial array was already operating at its peak, and the black evil energy continued to spread downward along the dragon veins, eroding the entire land veins outside the pass.

"This is the Dragon Vein Sacrifice Altar that has been operated by the three Japanese sects for many years." Lin Jia looked at the magnificent and strange scene in front of her and said in a solemn tone, "Three levels of defense, the outer altar guards, the middle altar thousands of Gu, and the main altar curse masters and ghost generals, all linked together to kill each other."

Oda Miko was being held behind by Li Erniu, looking at the altar on the top of the mountain with complicated eyes: "All the remaining Koga ninjas in the outer altar are guarding the altar. In the middle altar, all the top Gu masters of the Jiuju sect are in charge, controlling the Ten Thousand Gu Formation. In the main altar, three great spell masters are presiding over the sacrifices, and the ghost generals are guarding the airspace. Even if you break in here, you will not be able to break this deadly situation."

Hu Jiulang's gaze slowly swept across the triple altar, his heavenly eye discerning all the formation veins, aura nodes, and human hand arrangements. After a moment, he spoke in a deep voice:

"The outer altar uses the ghost pillar as the center of the formation, and sets up the Yin Soul Locking Formation. The guarding ninjas are just a cover. The real killing is the thousands of ghosts imprisoned by the ghost pillar; the middle altar's Ten Thousand Gu Array is based on the Gu Pond, with poisonous miasma sealing the air, poisonous insects everywhere, and many Gu cultivators.The master secretly controls the formation, and when the formation is broken, the formation will be destroyed; the main altar sacrifice formation is connected to the underground dragon veins, and the three great spell masters are each other's horns. The ghost will control the airspace. As long as the spell master does not fall, the formation will not stop and the calamity will continue to spread."

"If you want to break the situation, you must proceed step by step." Hu Jiulang quickly finalized the attack strategy, "First clear the outer altar, destroy the ghost pillar formation, clear out the remaining ninjas, and cut off the help of the ghosts; then break into the middle altar, break the ten thousand poison array, subdue the Jiuju Gu Master, purify the poisonous miasma Gu pool; finally rush to the main altar, interrupt the curse master's sacrifice, defeat the ghost general, and completely destroy the Dragon Vein Sacrifice Formation."
